purpose: Teach: 試乗/躍進/ビデオカメラ/刻印/副題/休職/借用/発令

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新型モデルの試乗会を全国展開しましょう
lines.en: Let's roll the new model's test-drive events out nationwide.
lines.style: Bright proposal energy, leaning forward, a hopeful lift on 'nationwide,' inviting rather than ordering.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外シェア躍進のキャンペーンを準備します
lines.en: Sure. I'll get the campaign ready for pushing our overseas share up.
lines.style: Easy agreeable opening, relaxed collegial pace, quiet confidence on 'pushing our share up.'

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内ビデオカメラの稼働確認を毎月しましょう
lines.en: And let's check that the office video cameras are actually running every month.
lines.style: Practical, list-ticking rhythm, a small wry stress on 'actually running,' friendly but thorough.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新製品の刻印工程を確認します
lines.en: Got it. I'll double-check the engraving process for the new product.
lines.style: Quick nodding acknowledgment, even and reliable, a note-to-self quality on 'double-check.'

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内報の副題を社員から募集しましょう
lines.en: Oh — and let's have employees submit ideas for the newsletter's subtitle.
lines.style: A pleased little spark on the 'oh,' warming to her own idea, quicker and lighter through the suggestion.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。休職中の社員との連絡体制を整えます
lines.en: Right. I'll set up a proper system for keeping in touch with the folks on leave.
lines.style: Softens noticeably, sincere and considerate, gentle care on 'folks on leave,' unhurried close.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社外文献の借用ルールを統一しましょう
lines.en: Let's also standardize the rules for borrowing outside publications.
lines.style: Back to brisk efficiency, tidy and organized delivery, satisfaction of putting one more thing in order.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。緊急時の発令フローを再確認します
lines.en: Will do. I'll go back over the flow for issuing emergency directives, too.
lines.style: Wrapping-up cadence, calm and dependable, a light final downbeat that closes the planning session.
